data.title: Egypt Condemns Attacks on Saudi Arabia's Territory
data.content:
Cairo, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Arab Republic of Egypt has expressed its strong condemnation and denunciation of the attacks targeting civilian and economic facilities in Riyadh, which resulted in material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District. Egypt described these acts as a blatant violation of international law and international humanitarian law, an unacceptable assault on the Kingdom's sovereignty, and a threat to its security, stability, and the safety of its citizens.
    In a statement issued by its Foreign Ministry today, Egypt affirmed its categorical rejection of the continued attacks targeting the Kingdom's territory, stressing the need for an immediate cessation of these irresponsible acts that undermine regional security and stability.
    Egypt reiterated its full solidarity and unwavering support for the Kingdom regarding all measures taken to protect its security, sovereignty, and the safety of its citizens and residents, emphasizing that the security of the Kingdom is an integral part of both Egyptian and Arab national security.
    -- SPA
